name: io.github.robertkeus/gpyou
title: gpyou GPU availability
description: Live GPU stock and hourly prices from GPU clouds worldwide, cheapest first. No account needed.

tools.name: find_gpus
tools.description: GPUs in stock now on GPYou, worldwide: the cheapest machine per GPU model, GPU count, region and country, cheapest first, with its provider and the data centres or locations it runs in (empty when the provider names only the country). customer_hourly_micro_usd is the price per hour for the whole machine in millionths of a US dollar (1000000 is $1.00). The list is at most a minute old (age_seconds). other_clouds lists GPUs in stock at other GPU clouds, rented there and not through GPYou: the cheapest machine per provider, GPU model, GPU count and place, at most 100 rows, at the provider's own list price per hour for the whole machine (list_hourly_micro_usd; null when it publishes none in USD; some providers bill CPU, memory and disk on top). It is at most five minutes old (other_clouds_age_seconds).

inputSchema.description: The filters of `GET /v1/public/gpus` and of the MCP tool `find_gpus`; its JSON schema is the tool's input.

gpu.description: GPU model, whole words: H100, A100, RTX 4090. Leave out for every model.
gpu.title: Gpu

country.description: ISO country code, for example US.
country.title: Country

max_price.description: Highest price in USD per hour for the whole machine.
max_price.title: Max Price

inputSchema.title: GpuQuery
